channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: ARK Fantastic Tames Season 1
item.description: Fantastic Tames Season 1 brings three new companions: Burrowbuck, Cerberax, and Enigmasaur. Tunnel through the earth, tear through the front lines with multi-headed attacks, or mimic stolen creature-forms!

item.title: ARK Tides of Fortune
item.description: Build & customize your ships, and set sail for adventure across the high-seas this massive ARK gameplay expansion! Explore an uncharted ocean frontier to hunt for buried treasure, tame deep-sea monstrosities, and battle ruthless pirate armadas in PvE & PvP!

item.title: Grim Fandango Remastered
item.description: One of the most acclaimed adventure games of all time is now back, better than ever. Grim Fandango Remastered has the all the beautiful art and engaging story fans remember, but has also been remastered to look, sound, and control even better than the award-winning original release.

item.title: Lost Eidolons
item.description: Lost Eidolons is a turn-based tactical RPG with a gripping cinematic narrative, set in a waning empire riven by civil war. Take on the role of a charming mercenary captain, Eden, and lead his band of allies through epic encounters on a classic turn-based battlefield.

item.title: Lost Eidolons: Veil of the Witch
item.description: Veil of the Witch is a roguelite strategy RPG with turn-based combat and branching progression. Set in the world of “Lost Eidolons,” build a nimble squad of five, pick your skills as you level, and adapt to each unique run. May the gods favor the bold and the wise.

item.title: Phantom Spark
item.description: The best feeling racing game out there. Precision time-trial racing against npc champions in the campaign or other players on the leaderboards.

item.title: Rivals of Aether
item.description: RIVALS OF AETHER is an indie fighting game where warring civilizations summon the power of Fire, Water, Air, and Earth. Play with up to four players either locally or online.

item.title: SiN Reloaded
item.description: SiN: Reloaded is a completely remastered experience of the 1998 shooter. This diamond-in-the-rough, story-driven FPS features memorable characters, horrific enemies, and a devastating arsenal that pushed the Quake II Engine to its limits. Now with remastered graphics and overhauled control schemes.

item.title: Buggos 2
item.description: You are the Buggo Hivemind. In this low-micro swarm RTS you place spawners, set attack pins and send up to 5,000 bugs into the dirty Humans' walls and turrets. Evolve your swarm across a 45-mission campaign, then take it into Survival, Workshop maps or 4-player online battles.

item.title: Craftlings
item.description: Build a bustling settlement in a 2D logistics puzzle. Guide tiny workers through the routes you create, connect production chains, and solve handcrafted missions. Charming to watch, rewarding to figure out.

item.title: Popcorn & Premieren - Ausgehviertel
item.description: Expand your cinema with a leisure district featuring a pizzeria, beach club, restaurant, ice cream café, arcade, bowling, mini golf, stage and event hall. Upgrade businesses, manage your investment and collect parking fees, with real financial risks as well as opportunities.
